summary: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order.
takeaways: We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs.
We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists.
Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order.
